<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="app-version" content="0.8">
<title>Baggio — Sistema de filtragem</title>
<!--
  BAGGIO MONITOR v0.8  (SOMENTE LEITURA)
  HISTORICO
    v0.8  T da alimentacao (um ramo sobe, o outro desce); simulacao sem falha de comunicacao; Falha e Alerta de demonstracao
          sempre ativos na simulacao; filtros e caixas de selecao em Alertas e falhas.
    v0.7  Setas geradas do tubo (mesmo sentido da animacao); afastamento padrao de 24 entre tubos; ponte no cruzamento;
          valvulas alinhadas ao eixo do tubo; sem sobreposicao de rotulos; simulador sem silencio.
    v0.6  Sem "Hagane" na tela; Dados: PLC | Simulados; tubo ligado ao tanque limpo; valvula quebra vacuo; Alertas e falhas
          no padrao do medidor (codigo, efeito, causa, solucao, como o PLC decide) a partir dos blocos do PLC.
    v0.5  Sem deslocamento de UI (aviso fixo no rodape, espaco reservado); tubo do extrator emendado no funil.
    v0.4  Nome Baggio (Hagane = fabrica); fonte CPU/Simulacao no proprio HTML; nivel dos tanques pelos sensores com
          animacao da agua (liga/desliga); 6 colisoes de texto corrigidas.
    v0.3  Dois visuais (Moderno = identidade do medidor; Original = WinCC); menos informacao repetida.
    v0.2  Overview fiel a tela do WinCC (Baggio - Sistema de agua); clique na lampada = detalhe.
    v0.1  Primeira versao: Overview, Alertas e falhas, Entradas e saidas.
  COMO FUNCIONA
    A pagina so le /baggio/api/estado (1 s) e /baggio/api/tags do Node-RED.
    Nao existe nenhum botao de comando. Se a leitura falha ou fica velha, a tela diz
    "SEM COMUNICACAO" e apaga os valores (nunca mostra valor velho como se fosse atual).
  ORGANIZACAO DO CODIGO (secoes neste arquivo)
    1. Config   2. Dados (API/estado)   3. Mapa (equipamentos)   4. Alarmes
    5. Overview 6. Alertas              7. E/S      8. Cabecalho/abas   9. Inicio
-->
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#e8ecef; --panel:#ffffff; --ink:#1b2a33; --muted:#586873; --line:#c8d1d7;
  --head:#0b4a5c; --head-ink:#ffffff;
  --run:#1c7f55; --run-bg:#dff2e8; --warn:#9a6700; --warn-bg:#fff1cc;
  --bad:#b3261e; --bad-bg:#fde3e1; --off:#7d8a93; --off-bg:#eef1f3;
  --liq:#5aa7c7; --sujo:#c9b24a; --focus:#0a64ad;
  --font:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%}
body{font:14px/1.35 var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:1px}

/* ---- cabecalho ---- */
header{background:var(--head);color:var(--head-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
header h1{font-size:17px;margin:0;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.02em;flex:1 1 auto;white-space:nowrap}
header h1 small{font-weight:400;opacity:.8;margin-left:8px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 11px;font-weight:650;font-size:12.5px;border:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap}
.pill.real{background:#fff;color:#0b4a5c}
.pill.demo{background:#ffd23f;color:#3b2f00;border-color:#3b2f00;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pill.com-ok{background:var(--run-bg);color:var(--run)}
.pill.com-bad{background:var(--bad);color:#fff}
.pill.com-nd{background:var(--off-bg);color:var(--muted)}
#relogio{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;opacity:.9;font-size:13px}

/* ---- abas ---- */
nav{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:2px;padding:0 10px;overflow-x:auto}
nav button{border:0;background:none;padding:11px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);border-bottom:4px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap}
nav button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--head);border-bottom-color:var(--head)}
nav .cnt{display:inline-block;min-width:22px;text-align:center;margin-left:6px;border-radius:11px;padding:0 6px;background:var(--off-bg);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
nav .cnt.ativo{background:var(--bad);color:#fff}
nav .cnt.aviso{background:var(--warn);color:#fff}

/* ---- faixa de situacao (sempre visivel) ---- */
#faixa{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 16px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600}
#faixa .luz{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--off);background:transparent;flex:none}
.dot.on-g{background:var(--run);border-color:var(--run)}
.dot.on-y{background:#e0a800;border-color:#9a6700}
.dot.on-r{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad)}
.dot.nd{border-style:dashed}

/* ---- aviso de comunicacao ---- */
#aviso{display:none;background:var(--bad);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:700}
#aviso small{font-weight:400;display:block;opacity:.95}
body.sem-com #aviso{display:block}
body.sem-com .dados{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.45}
#conf{display:none;background:var(--warn-bg);padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#conf input{font:inherit;padding:5px 8px;width:min(340px,70vw)}

header,nav,#faixa,#aviso,#conf{flex:none}   /* nao encolher no celular */
main{flex:1;padding:12px 16px 20px;min-width:0}
.vista{display:none}
.vista.ativa{display:block}
.barra{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.barra h2{margin:0;font-size:16px}
.info-btn{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--muted);background:#fff;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.pop{position:fixed;z-index:30;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:14px 16px;max-width:min(460px,92vw);max-height:80vh;overflow:auto}
.pop h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px}
.pop .fechar{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px}
.pop p,.pop li{margin:.3em 0}

/* ---- overview ---- */
.ov{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 250px;gap:12px;align-items:start}
.painel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px}
.painel h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted)}
.svgwrap{overflow:auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
#svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - var(--alt-svg,170px));margin:0 auto}
.lin{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lin:last-child{border:0}
.lin .t{flex:1}
.lin .v{font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lin.ativo .v{color:var(--run)}
.lin.ruim.ativo .v{color:var(--bad)}
/* svg: estados de equipamento */
.eq rect.f{fill:var(--off-bg);stroke:var(--off);stroke-width:1.5}
.eq.run rect.f{fill:var(--run-bg);stroke:var(--run);stroke-width:2.5}
.eq.fail rect.f{fill:var(--bad-bg);stroke:var(--bad);stroke-width:3}
.eq.nd rect.f{stroke-dasharray:5 3}
.eq text{font-family:var(--font);fill:var(--ink)}
.eq .n{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:650}
.eq .s{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;fill:var(--muted)}
.eq.run .s{fill:var(--run)}
.eq.fail .s{fill:var(--bad)}
.eq .ic{fill:none;stroke:var(--off);stroke-width:2}
.eq.run .ic{stroke:var(--run)}
.eq.fail .ic{stroke:var(--bad)}
.tubo{stroke:#9fb0ba;stroke-width:5;fill:none;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tubo.vivo{stroke:var(--liq)}
.tanque{fill:#fff;stroke:#52646e;stroke-width:2.5}
.nivel-l{fill:var(--liq);opacity:.75}
.nivel-s{fill:var(--sujo);opacity:.8}
.rot{font:11.5px var(--font);fill:var(--muted)}
.rot .b{font-weight:700}
.sen circle{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--off);stroke-width:2}
.sen.on circle{fill:var(--run);stroke:var(--run)}
.sen text{font:11px var(--font);fill:var(--ink)}
.vlv path{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--off);stroke-width:2}
.vlv.on path{fill:var(--run);stroke:var(--run)}
.vlv text{font:11px var(--font);fill:var(--ink)}
.vlv.nd path{stroke-dasharray:3 2}
.banda{fill:none;stroke:#6f7f89;stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:8 6}
.banda.gira{animation:desl 1.2s linear infinite}
@keyframes desl{to{stroke-dashoffset:-28}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.banda.gira{animation:none}}

/* ---- overview fiel ao WinCC (v0.2) ---- */
.tela{background:#d5d9dc;border:1px solid #9aa3a8}
.tela-tit{background:#0d4a5e;color:#fff;font:700 15px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;padding:6px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.tela-tit .info-btn{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.tela .svgwrap{border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent}
#svg text{font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
.rt{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;fill:#1b2a33}
.rt2{font-size:12px;fill:#1b2a33}
.rt3{font-size:13.5px;fill:#1b2a33}
.seta{font-size:14px;fill:#1b2a33}
.eqp{fill:#cfd3d6;stroke:#6f7a80;stroke-width:1.5}
.eqp2{fill:#b3b9bd;stroke:#6f7a80;stroke-width:1.5}
.pnl{fill:#c3c8cc;stroke:#9aa3a8}
.tb-o{fill:none;stroke:#2b9a43;stroke-width:9;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.tb-i{fill:none;stroke:#7be884;stroke-width:5;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.tb-o.ar{stroke:#2c5cb5}.tb-i.ar{stroke:#7aa6f2}
.tb-ponta{fill:#7be884;stroke:#2b9a43;stroke-width:2.5}
.lp{cursor:pointer}
.lp circle{fill:url(#gOff);stroke:#59646a;stroke-width:1}
.lp.on circle{fill:url(#gOn);stroke:#0f6a2c}
.lp.fail circle{fill:url(#gFail);stroke:#7d120c}
.lp.nd circle{fill:#e4e7e9;stroke-dasharray:2 2}
.lpx{font:700 11px Arial,sans-serif;fill:#fff;pointer-events:none}
.lp.nd .lpx{fill:#59646a}
.vl{cursor:pointer}
.vl path{fill:#eef0f1;stroke:#59646a;stroke-width:1.3}
.vl.on path{fill:#35c75a;stroke:#0f6a2c}
.vl.nd path{stroke-dasharray:2 2}
.hz{fill:#fff;stroke:#8d969c}
.hzt{font-size:12px;fill:#1b2a33}
@media (max-width:900px){ #svg{min-width:900px} }

/* ---- alertas ---- */
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{background:#f3f6f8;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted)}
td.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
tr.ativo td{background:var(--bad-bg)}
tr.ativo.sev-alarme td{background:var(--warn-bg)}
tr.inativo td{color:var(--muted)}
.sev{display:inline-block;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:1.5px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap}
.sev.emergencia{color:#fff;background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad)}
.sev.critico{color:var(--bad)}
.sev.alarme{color:var(--warn)}
.sev.campo{color:var(--muted)}
.vazio{padding:26px;text-align:center;background:var(--panel);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;color:var(--run);font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
label.chk{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer}
.btn{border:1.5px solid var(--head);background:#fff;color:var(--head);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 12px;font-weight:600}
.btn:hover{background:#eef6f8}
h3.sec{margin:18px 0 8px;font-size:14px}

/* ---- e/s ---- */
.grade{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:10px}
.byte{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px}
.byte h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--head)}
.bit{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:3px 0}
.bit .a{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12.5px;width:46px;flex:none;color:var(--muted)}
.bit .d{flex:1;font-size:13px}
.bit .d small{color:var(--muted);display:block;font-size:11px}
.bit .e{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;width:34px;text-align:right;flex:none}
.bit.on .e{color:var(--run)}
.bit.nd .e{color:var(--off)}
.warn{color:var(--warn);font-weight:700}
input[type=search]{font:inherit;padding:6px 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;min-width:200px}
.sub{display:flex;gap:6px}
.sub button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 14px;font-weight:600}
.sub button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--head);color:#fff;border-color:var(--head)}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .ov{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  header{padding:6px 12px;gap:6px}
  header h1{font-size:15px;flex-basis:100%}
  header h1 small{display:none}
  .pill{font-size:12px;padding:2px 9px}
  main{padding:8px 10px 16px}
  th.h-origem,td.h-origem{display:none}
}

/* ============ v0.3 · cabecalho: selo de estado e chave de visual ============ */
.pill.st-run{background:var(--run-bg);color:var(--run)}
.pill.st-warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn)}
.pill.st-bad{background:var(--bad);color:#fff}
.pill.st-off,.pill.st-nd{background:var(--off-bg);color:var(--muted)}
.vis{display:inline-flex;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
.vis button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;padding:3px 11px;font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px}
.vis button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#fff;color:var(--head)}
.tela{position:relative}
.info-flut{display:none;position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;z-index:2}
body.tema-ori #site{display:none}               /* no Original o local ja aparece na barra do WinCC */

/* ============ v0.3 · visual MODERNO (identidade do medidor) ============ */
body.tema-mod{
  --bg:#f3f5f8; --panel:#ffffff; --ink:#141414; --muted:#5b6b7e; --line:#dde2e8;
  --head:#1a4a78; --acento:#ec7000;
  --run:#1f7a4d; --run-bg:#e3f3ea; --warn:#b45f00; --warn-bg:#fff0dc;
  --bad:#c62828; --bad-bg:#fde8e8; --off:#8a98a8; --off-bg:#eef1f5; --focus:#1a4a78;
  --font:system-ui,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --alt-svg:140px;
}
body.tema-mod nav button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--head);border-bottom-color:var(--acento)}
body.tema-mod .tela-tit{display:none}
body.tema-mod .info-flut{display:inline-block}
body.tema-mod .tela{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
body.tema-mod #svg text{font-family:var(--font)}
body.tema-mod .cv{fill:var(--panel)}
body.tema-mod .cvp{display:none}
body.tema-mod .eqp{fill:#eef1f5;stroke:#8a98a8;stroke-width:1.5}
body.tema-mod .eqp2{fill:#dfe5ec;stroke:#8a98a8;stroke-width:1.5}
body.tema-mod .pnl{fill:#f3f5f8;stroke:var(--line)}
body.tema-mod .tb-i{display:none}
body.tema-mod .tb-o{stroke:#3d86b8;stroke-width:4.5}
body.tema-mod .tb-o.ar{stroke:#1a4a78}
body.tema-mod .tb-ponta{fill:#3d86b8;stroke:none}
body.tema-mod .liq{fill:#f2c94c;opacity:.9}
body.tema-mod .seg{stroke:var(--acento);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:4 4}
body.tema-mod .rt,body.tema-mod .rt2,body.tema-mod .rt3,body.tema-mod .seta{fill:var(--ink)}
body.tema-mod .rt{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600}
body.tema-mod .lp circle{fill:#d3dae2;stroke:#8a98a8;stroke-width:1.5}
body.tema-mod .lp.on circle{fill:var(--run);stroke:var(--run)}
body.tema-mod .lp.fail circle{fill:var(--bad);stroke:var(--bad)}
body.tema-mod .lp.nd circle{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--off)}
body.tema-mod .vl path{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--muted);stroke-width:1.5}
body.tema-mod .vl.on path{fill:var(--run);stroke:var(--run)}
body.tema-mod .hz{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--line)}
body.tema-mod .hzt{fill:var(--muted)}

/* ============ v0.3 · MODERNO no escuro (como o medidor: segue o sistema) ============ */
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  body.tema-mod{
    --bg:#10161d; --panel:#18212b; --ink:#e8edf2; --muted:#93a3b5; --line:#2a3744; --head:#0f2e4d;
    --run:#4cc38a; --run-bg:#143025; --warn:#f2a54a; --warn-bg:#352612;
    --bad:#cf4242; --bad-bg:#3a1a1a; --off:#6c7c8e; --off-bg:#1f2933; --focus:#7fb4ea;
  }
  body.tema-mod nav,body.tema-mod table,body.tema-mod .pop,body.tema-mod .byte,body.tema-mod .painel{background:var(--panel)}
  body.tema-mod th{background:#1f2933}
  body.tema-mod .btn,body.tema-mod .info-btn,body.tema-mod input[type=search],body.tema-mod .sub button,body.tema-mod #conf input{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink)}
  body.tema-mod .sub button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#2a5d94;color:#fff}
  body.tema-mod .pill.real{background:#e8edf2;color:#0f2e4d}
  body.tema-mod nav button[aria-selected="true"]{color:#fff}
  body.tema-mod .eqp{fill:#222e3a;stroke:#6c7c8e}
  body.tema-mod .eqp2{fill:#2a3745;stroke:#6c7c8e}
  body.tema-mod .pnl{fill:#1f2933}
  body.tema-mod .tb-o{stroke:#4f9ccf}
  body.tema-mod .tb-o.ar{stroke:#7fb4ea}
  body.tema-mod .tb-ponta{fill:#4f9ccf}
  body.tema-mod .liq{fill:#b8932a}
  body.tema-mod .lp circle{fill:#3a4756;stroke:#6c7c8e}
  body.tema-mod .lp.on circle{stroke:var(--run)}
  body.tema-mod .vl path{fill:#18212b}
  body.tema-mod tr.ativo td{color:var(--ink)}
}

/* ============ v0.4 · marca/fabrica, animacao, liquidos ============ */
body.tema-mod .h-fab{display:none}
body.tema-ori .h-marca{display:none}
.anim-sw{position:absolute;top:6px;right:12px;z-index:2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
body.tema-mod .anim-sw{right:46px;top:9px;color:var(--ink)}
.anim-sw input{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--acento,#ec7000)}
.liqg{transition:none}
.liq{fill:#ecea00}                                  /* Original: amarelo do WinCC */
.liqL{fill:#7ec8e8;opacity:.8}
.liq2{opacity:.55;fill:#fff3a0}
body.tema-mod .liq2{fill:#ffe9a0}
body.tema-mod .liqL{fill:#6fb3dc;opacity:.85}
.tb-f{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-opacity:.9;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:1 13;display:none}
body.anim .tb-f.vivo{display:inline}
body.anim .tb-f.vivo{animation:fluxo .9s linear infinite}
body.anim .tb-f.vivo.rev{animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes fluxo{to{stroke-dashoffset:-14}}
body.anim .liqg{transition:transform 1.8s ease-in-out}
body.anim .ondas{animation:onda 5s linear infinite}
body.anim .ondas2{animation-duration:8s;animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes onda{to{transform:translateX(-46px)}}
body.anim .ondas2{animation-name:onda2}
@keyframes onda2{to{transform:translateX(-70px)}}
body.anim .ondasL{animation-name:ondaL;animation-duration:4s}
@keyframes ondaL{to{transform:translateX(-40px)}}
@media (max-width:900px){ .anim-sw{top:6px} }

.menu-wrap{position:relative;margin-left:auto}
.menu{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 4px);z-index:30;min-width:270px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:4px}
.menu[hidden]{display:none}
.menu button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:600}

.al-hist-bar{margin-top:6px}

.al-hist-bar .btn{margin-top:12px}
.al-tab .al-lin{cursor:pointer}

.cod{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.tp{display:inline-block;padding:1px 9px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.tp-F.tp{background:var(--bad);color:#fff}
.tp-A.tp{border:1.5px solid var(--warn);color:var(--warn)}
.tp-I.tp{border:1.5px solid var(--off);color:var(--muted)}
tr.ativo.tp-F td{background:var(--bad-bg)}
tr.ativo.tp-A td{background:var(--warn-bg)}
tr.ativo.tp-I td{background:var(--off-bg)}
tr.al-det td{padding:0;background:var(--panel);border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
.corpo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px 22px;padding:14px 18px 16px;max-width:1400px}
.corpo h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:14px}
.corpo p,.corpo ol,.corpo ul{margin:.3em 0}
.corpo ol{padding-left:20px}
.corpo ul.sol{list-style:none;padding:0}
.corpo ul.sol li{margin:6px 0}
.onde{display:inline-block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:0 6px;margin-right:6px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.corpo .plc{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:6px}
.plc dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 12px;margin:6px 0}
.plc dt{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.plc dd{margin:0}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:0 8px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12.5px}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--run);color:var(--run);background:var(--run-bg)}
.chip.nd{border-style:dashed;color:var(--muted)}
.obs{background:var(--warn-bg);border-left:4px solid var(--warn);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:4px}
.peq{font-size:12px}

// [F] SIMULADOR PURO (DEMO): simularBytes(contrato, agoraMs) devolve os MESMOS bytes que a CPU enviaria
// [F] ({"IB0":n,...}) ou null (silencio = teste de "sem comunicacao"). Sem PLC, sem rede.
// [F] Usado em 2 lugares com o MESMO codigo: fluxo demo do Node-RED e simulador embutido no HTML.
// [F] Ciclo de 180 s: 40-70 s aviso (permissivel); 100-140 s falha critica na bomba 1; 150-165 s silencio.
// [F] Nivel do tanque sujo sobe e desce a cada 60 s e e entregue pelos SENSORES (sensor ativo = coberto):
// [F]   I6.1 minimo >= 15 %, I6.2 inicio de enchimento >= 40 %, I6.3 fim de enchimento >= 70 %, I6.0 maximo >= 90 %.
// [F] Tanque limpo (compensacao) oscila a cada 90 s: I6.5 minimo >= 15 %, I6.4 maximo >= 85 %.
// [F] Nunca usar em producao: a tela exibe "DEMO" em destaque (licao Demo x Real).
function simularBytes(contrato, agoraMs) {
  var t = (agoraMs / 1000) % 180;
  if (t >= 150 && t < 165) return null;
  var B = {};
  var set = function (end, v) {
    var m = /^([IQM])(\d+)\.(\d)$/.exec(end); if (!m) return;
    var k = m[1] + "B" + m[2]; B[k] = (B[k] || 0);
    if (v) B[k] |= (1 << Number(m[3])); else B[k] &= ~(1 << Number(m[3]));
  };
  contrato.tags.forEach(function (tg) { if (tg.bit && B[tg.byte] === undefined) B[tg.byte] = 0; });

  var falhaBomba1 = t >= 100 && t < 140, aviso = t >= 40 && t < 70;
  var fase = (t % 60) / 60, nivel = fase < 0.5 ? fase * 2 : 2 - fase * 2;          // tanque sujo 0..1
  var nl = 0.55 + 0.35 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * t / 90);                           // tanque limpo 0..1
  var limpeza = (t % 90) >= 20 && (t % 90) < 50;

  // base: comando, seguranca, disjuntores OK, ar, modo automatico
  ["I0.0","I0.3","I0.6","I4.2","I4.4","I5.0","I5.2","I5.4","I5.6","I1.0","I1.4","I2.0","I2.2","I2.4","I3.0","I3.5","Q12.1","Q12.2"].forEach(function (a) { set(a, true); });
  // sensores de nivel do tanque sujo (entradas) e lampadas do sinotico (saidas)
  set("I6.1", nivel >= 0.15); set("I6.2", nivel >= 0.40); set("I6.3", nivel >= 0.70); set("I6.0", nivel >= 0.90);
  set("Q14.6", nivel >= 0.90); set("Q14.7", nivel >= 0.70); set("Q15.0", nivel < 0.40); set("Q15.1", nivel < 0.15);
  // tanque limpo
  set("I6.5", nl >= 0.15); set("I6.4", nl >= 0.85); set("Q14.4", nl >= 0.85); set("Q14.5", nl < 0.15);
  // bombas
  var b1 = !falhaBomba1, b2 = nivel > 0.5;
  set("I1.1", b1); set("I1.2", b1); set("Q13.0", b1);
  set("I1.5", b2); set("I1.6", b2); set("Q13.1", b2);
  set("I2.1", true); set("Q13.6", true);
  // ciclo de autolimpeza
  set("Q12.4", limpeza);
  set("I2.3", limpeza); set("Q13.4", limpeza); set("Q14.1", limpeza); set("Q14.3", limpeza);
  set("I3.1", limpeza); set("Q13.5", limpeza);
  set("I3.6", true); set("Q13.2", true); set("I2.5", true); set("Q13.3", true);
  set("Q15.3", true); set("Q15.4", true); set("Q14.0", true); set("Q15.6", b2); set("Q14.2", nl > 0.5);
  // coluna sinaleira
  set("Q11.4", !falhaBomba1);
  if (aviso) { set("M13.7", true); set("M21.3", true); set("Q11.6", true); }
  if (falhaBomba1) { set("M12.2", true); set("M122.2", true); set("M21.0", true); set("Q11.5", true); set("Q11.7", true); }
  return B;
}

  fonte: "cpu", simUltimo: null,
  /* SIMULACAO: gera o estado no proprio navegador (mesmo codigo do fluxo demo). Nada de rede. */
  lerSim(){
    if (!this.contrato) { this.contrato = CONTRATO_EMB; this.tagsPorEnd = {}; CONTRATO_EMB.tags.forEach(t=>this.tagsPorEnd[t.endereco]=t); }
    const B = simularBytes(CONTRATO_EMB, Date.now());
    if (B) { const bits = {}; CONTRATO_EMB.tags.forEach(t=>{ const v=B[t.byte]; if (typeof v==="number") bits[t.endereco]=((v>>t.nbit)&1)===1; }); this.simUltimo = {ts:Date.now(), bits}; }
    const u = this.simUltimo;
    this.falhas = 0;
    this.estado = {versao:VERSAO, origem:"demo", agora:Date.now(), ts:u.ts, idade_ms:0, comunicacao:"ok", motivo:"", bits:u.bits};   // simulacao: SEMPRE ok
    this.definirCom(false, "");
    this.ultimoOk = Date.now();
  },
  /* troca de fonte em funcionamento: zera o que veio da fonte anterior */
  trocarFonte(f){
    this.fonte = f; this.contrato = null; this.estado = null; this.tagsPorEnd = {}; this.simUltimo = null;
    this.falhas = 0; this.semCom = true; this.motivo = "aguardando 1ª leitura"; this.semDesde = Date.now();
    Alarmes.defs = []; Alarmes.estado = {}; Alarmes.iniciado = false; TelaES.montadoAnalog = false;
    gravarStorage("baggio_fonte", f);
    $$("#fonteSel button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.dataset.fonte===f));
    this.ler();
  },
  async ler(){
    if (this.fonte === "sim") { this.lerSim(); this.ouvintes.forEach(f=>{ try{ f(); }catch(e){ console.error(e); } }); return; }
    const f0 = this.fonte;                 // fonte no inicio desta leitura
    try {
      if (!this.contrato) await this.carregarContrato();
      if (this.fonte !== f0) { this.contrato = null; return; }          // trocou de fonte durante a espera: descarta
      const e = await this.buscar("/baggio/api/estado");
      if (this.fonte !== f0) return;                                     // idem: resposta velha de outra fonte
      this.falhas = 0; this.estado = e;
      const ok = e.comunicacao === "ok" && e.idade_ms != null && e.idade_ms <= Cfg.velhoMs;
      this.definirCom(!ok, ok ? "" : (e.motivo || "dados velhos"));
      if (ok) this.ultimoOk = Date.now();
    } catch (err) {
      if (this.fonte !== f0) return;                                     // erro de uma fonte que ja foi trocada
      this.falhas++;
      if (this.falhas >= Cfg.falhasParaCair) this.definirCom(true, "Node-RED não responde ("+(err.message||err)+")");
    }
    this.ouvintes.forEach(f=>{ try{ f(); }catch(e){ console.error(e); } });
  },
  definirCom(sem, motivo){
    if (sem && !this.semCom) this.semDesde = Date.now();
    this.semCom = sem; this.motivo = motivo;
  },
  iniciar(){ this.ler(); setInterval(()=>this.ler(), Cfg.pollMs); }
};
